portInfo.description: Crotone’s identity is rooted in the Greek colony of Kroton and the later walled city. The cathedral and fortress sit within the older urban fabric, while Capo Colonna, Le Castella and Santa Severina belong to the wider province. A cruise day should distinguish that regional reach from a short stroll out of the port.

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality. Many visitors use Schengen short-stay rules, but requirements change—confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: The operator locates the terminal at Banchina di Riva and gives the city centre as 250 m away without specifying endpoints. Budget 30–45 minutes for gangway, controlled exit and a town approach rather than turning that into an exact walking route. Capo Colonna needs a separate road transfer; allow 45 minutes each way as a cautious planning block, including pickup. Le Castella or Santa Severina require their own longer road plan, not a few extra minutes tacked onto a city walk.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Cathedral of Santa Maria Assunta, Cathedral of Santa Maria Assunta, Crotone old town: A defined historic-city stop close to the old lanes. Allow about 45 minutes (editorial estimate). Worship and visitor entry differ; confirm interior access.

Castle of Charles V, Castello di Carlo V, Crotone historic acropolis: Read the fortress exteriors and changing defensive architecture. Allow about 75 minutes (editorial estimate). Interior/tower access not established; do not promise a castle museum tour.

Capo Colonna archaeological area, Sanctuary of Hera Lacinia, Capo Colonna, Crotone: A separate coastal archaeological destination associated with ancient Kroton. Allow about 120 minutes (editorial estimate). Road transfer and current public visitor route must be confirmed.

Le Castella fortress setting, Aragonese Castle, Le Castella, Isola di Capo Rizzuto: A provincial coastal-castle alternative for a dedicated longer excursion. Allow about 90 minutes (editorial estimate). Not Crotone centre; confirm castle admission and a waiting return vehicle.

Santa Severina village and castle, Norman Castle/Santa Severina village centre, Crotone province: An inland hill-village alternative, not another stop in the harbour district. Allow about 120 minutes (editorial estimate). Separate road itinerary; steps and current castle entry need checking.
